subject: FY27 Preliminary Operating Budget
overview: The School Committee held a public hearing on the superintendent's preliminary FY27 operating budget and voted to approve the recommended general fund appropriation, stabilization fund transfer, and capital free cash request. The revised proposal outlines $3.3 million in net reductions to address an existing gap between school needs and the city's funding allocation.

items.title: Superintendent's Recommended FY27 Operating Budget
items.summary: Approved the administration's budget recommendations—including the general fund appropriation, stabilization fund transfer, and free cash requests—with direction to prioritize reinstating the vacant inclusion specialist position as soon as funds allow.
